verse.unicode: ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਡਹਕਾਵੈ ਓਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥

transliteration.english: jatan karai maanukh ddahakaavai oh a(n)tarajaamee jaanai ||

en.bdb: People try to deceive others, but the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows everything.

verse.unicode: ਪਾਪ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਮੂਕਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਭੇਖ ਕਰੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੈ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: paap kare kar mookar paavai bhekh karai nirabaanai ||1||

en.bdb: They commit sins, and then deny them, while they pretend to be in Nirvaanaa. ||1||
They believe that You are far away, but You, O God, are near at hand.

verse.unicode: ਉਤ ਤਾਕੈ ਉਤ ਤੇ ਉਤ ਪੇਖੈ ਆਵੈ ਲੋਭੀ ਫੇਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: aut taakai ut te ut pekhai aavai lobhee fer || rahaau ||

en.bdb: Looking around, this way and that, the greedy people come and go. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਭਰਮਾ ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥

transliteration.english: jab lag tuTai naahee man bharamaa tab lag mukat na koiee ||

en.bdb: As long as the doubts of the mind are not removed, liberation is not found.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੰਤੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੬॥

transliteration.english: kahu naanak dhiaal suaamee sa(n)t bhagat jan soiee ||2||5||36||

en.bdb: Says Nanak, he alone is a Saint, a devotee, and a humble servant of the Lord, to whom the Lord and Master is merciful. ||2||5||36||
